name: IA SEO Generator
author: mediterraneaservices

sections.description:
Be visible in AI search. IA SEO Generator creates a clean, AI-readable /llms.txt so modern assistants and AI crawlers can discover and understand your site — without risky root writes. Appear in answers on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Comet and more by providing the structured signals they expect.

What you get (Free)
– One-click llms.txt generation (no filesystem/root writes)
– Preview, Copy, Download or serve /llms.txt dynamically (save Permalinks once)
– Structured output with header metadata (site, site_name, ISO date, language)
– Pages/Posts sections (Title, URL, Updated, Excerpt)
– Built-in llms.txt language selector (EN/ES)
– Lightweight admin UI in English, i18n-ready for GlotPress language packs
– No tracking, no phone-home

Who is it for?
Stores, corporate sites, blogs and agencies that want their content to be understood by AI assistants and LLM search.

How it works
1. Install and activate IA SEO Generator.
2. Click Generate to build the file.
3. (Optional) Enable dynamic /llms.txt and visit Settings → Permalinks → Save once.

Go Premium and get all these advantages

  • ✔️ Fully automatic upload of the generated files
  • ✔️ AI-optimized files: llms.txt, humans.txt, metadata.json, sitemap.xml, ai-plugin.json
  • ✔️ Generate, View and Edit the content of each file
  • ✔️ Indexing in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Comet and more
  • ✔️ AI MODE Google Ready

  • ✔️ Compatible with all WordPress builders
  • ✔️ Priority support and continuous improvements

Engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Copilot do not work like Google. If your site is not properly structured for AI, it simply does not appear. And that means one thing: you are losing customers.

The Premium version of IA SEO Generator turns your website into information readable and preferred by these new AIs. The result? Greater visibility, more qualified traffic and more conversions. Ideal for online stores, corporate websites, blogs and professional services.

Be the first in your sector to appear in AI results and multiply your digital reach. It is not the future, it is the present.

Why are these files so important?
Files such as llms.txt, humans.txt, metadata.json, sitemap.xml or ai-plugin.json are essential for AIs to understand your site. While traditional search engines parse HTML, generative AIs look for structured, clear and standardized files.

Generating these files not only improves your visibility now, it strategically positions you for the future. It is the way to tell AI: “here is my content, perfectly organized and ready to be indexed.”

sections.faq:
Why doesn’t it write the file in the root?

Due to WordPress.org policies. This plugin offers safe alternatives: dynamic endpoint, download and copy.

How do I enable dynamic /llms.txt?

Settings → Permalinks → Save (no changes needed). Then visit /llms.txt on your site.

Can I force Spanish or English in llms.txt independently of the UI?

Yes. Use the selector llms.txt language (Auto / EN / ES).
